extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic data were extracted from Fig. 1, Table 1, Fig. 2A-B, and Table 4. Literature-comparison rows in Table 1 other than CoIn-BP-1 were excluded. Fig. 2C stability contains many dense plotted points; only the printed/clear induction-period values reported in Table 4 and the stable 16 h/Table 1 value were extracted. Supporting Information figures/tables mentioned in the article were not available in the provided full text, so Fig. S1/S2 data were not extracted. Feed H2/CO2 ratio and reactor catalyst mass/flow are not reported in the provided main text.
